name: Issue 3128: Elements of Fury lets Palm Sigil: Arcane affect one additional instance of damage
contract: Elements of Fury 707413 reads 'Your Palm Sigils now affect $s1 additional instance of damage.' Effect 0 is a flat
SPELLMOD_CHARGES (4) of 1 on family 38 mask0 0x04000000 mask2 0x2000, which Palm Sigil: Arcane 805380 (mask2
0x2000) carries. The sigil has DBC ProcCharges 0 and spell_proc -805380 Charges 0, so Aura::CalcMaxCharges gives
0 charges without the talent and 1 with it, while aura_ascension_arcane_palm_sigil removes the aura on its first
proc either way: the talent changed nothing. Expected: the sigil holds 2 charges with the talent; the first
direct Magic hit (Fire Blast) applies Palm Sigil: Arcane 807819 and leaves the sigil with 1 charge; a second
direct Magic hit (Ice Lance) applies 807819 again and consumes the sigil.
